name: PTC Inc.
moat_justification: Strong, not wide: Windchill PLM is the system of record for product data at large discrete manufacturers and Creo/Onshape sit inside daily engineering workflows, so ripping PTC out means migrating decades of product history — real switching costs, 95% recurring revenue (FY2025), and Gartner Leader positioning in PLM. Capped at 7 because Siemens (NX/Teamcenter) and Dassault (CATIA/ENOVIA) are equally entrenched at many of the same accounts, the SaaS/cloud transition (Windchill+, Onshape) gives customers a natural re-evaluation point, and end-demand is industrial capex, which is cyclical.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 12 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
one_liner: High-quality industrial-software franchise, moat 7/10, but standalone DCF does not clear 15% (weighted IRR 7.5%, IV@15 $70.46 vs $193.00 price; clears 15% only below ~$70) — the price is a Schneider takeover proxy: $205/share cash deal announced 2026-10-05, expected to close Q3 2027, so the live return is the ~6% deal spread, not the DCF.
moat_for: Windchill PLM is the system of record for product data — migration means moving decades of engineering history
Creo and Onshape embedded in daily engineering design workflows
95% recurring revenue in FY2025; ARR ex-divestitures $2.448B at Q3 FY26
Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for PLM (Windchill), highest on Ability to Execute (2026)
Breadth across CAD, PLM, ALM (Codebeamer) and SLM (ServiceMax) supports cross-sell / digital-thread lock-in
Asset-light: capex is de minimis vs OCF, so owner's earnings convert almost fully to cash
moat_against: Siemens (NX/Teamcenter) and Dassault Systemes (CATIA/ENOVIA) are equally entrenched rivals at the same accounts
SaaS/cloud migration (Windchill+, Onshape) is a natural re-evaluation point where share can be lost
End demand tied to discrete-manufacturing capex cycles — cyclical, not secular-only
ARR growth has decelerated to ~9% constant-currency — pricing/expansion power is real but not accelerating
SBC is a heavy, persistent cost ($240.7M TTM) — roughly a quarter of TTM operating cash flow
AI-driven design tools from larger platforms could compress the CAD/PLM value pool over the CAP
